cuts.head: with_body
cuts.ofreeRecent: a lakeside of flat rocks and still water — swimming breaststroke; a stone bridge over a town canal with lamp posts and boats passing below — holds a small hand lantern low at her side; the Zhuge Liang shrine on the Wuzhang Plains plateau — standing; overgrown jungle temple ruins — sitting on the ground; a Roman marble bath hall — standing; an art or pottery studio of easels — holds a tall iced coffee in a clear cup with a straw at chest height; a coin laundromat late at night — standing; a quiet memorial hall aboard a starship — holds a few lit incense sticks in both hands before her; a bright bathroom with a mirror — standing; the nave of a Gothic cathedral with stained-glass windows — kneeling on the ground; a misty enchanted garden of moss — straightens the wrapping paper around a small bouquet; a red carpet and award hall with camera flashes — standing; the long stone stairway of Baidicheng above the Yangtze gorge — standing
